first_accepted: Separately, all detections inside same case sorted by iteration then epoch; first replay status localized is irreversible first-accepted verdict; earlier wrong is never replaced by later correct.
health: Detection time outside all fault intervals is healthy candidate; classify its PROFILE overlap/pure health separately; all windows retain schedule order.
lineage: Retain source and parent_epoch for every in-fault detection; list all associated window outcomes in order.
strict_primary: Earliest detection with iteration inside frozen case fault interval; use exactly its epoch replay. No any-correct selection. Missing trigger/window remains miss/unavailable.
terminal: Separately list last logged localization associated with in-fault detections; never substitute it for primary strict or first-accepted.
